text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! I worked up a sweat there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pearl and I are at summer camp, and<n>we're making good progress through<n>the training regimen I prepared.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now we can enjoy our free time! Let<n>us go see the festival!
choice_data_list: You mean the summer festival nearby?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: No, no! I'm talking about a more<n>international festival! Here, take a<n>look at this invitation. Follow meee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We go to the location written on her<n>invitation. I don't remember any<n>summer festivals being held around<n>here...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Welcome, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: There!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Why did Pearl just make that<n>dramatic entrance?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl presents... the<n>International Carnival of Love and<n>Hope! Enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Feel the passion from the country of<n>sunshine! Dance to the beat of the<n>music!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I know it, I find myself swept<n>up in the flow and following Pearl's<n>dance steps!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What's up, Trainer! Say hoo!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My, looks like you're awfully fired<n>up, Trainer! I'll need to cool you<n>down. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This Asian summer festival will blast<n>the summer heat away! Let's<n>shooooot!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now, bring your eyes to the next<n>attraction—rocket magic!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pew, pew, peeew!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Firework rockets light up the night<n>sky. Faced with all of these<n>attractions, I can't help but feel a little<n>overwhelmed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fireworks displays are loved across<n>the world! May our year be blessed<n>with peace and great fortune! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The main dish is still to come! Let us<n>move to the uninhabited island!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, the stars are starting to come<n>out. How beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But what I really want to show you...<n>is a gemstone burning brightly in the<n>night sky...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So bright you can't help but reach out<n>and try to grasp it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pearl gives some sort of signal. Soon<n>after, a shrill sound pierces the quiet<n>night...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And the starry sky glitters with fiery<n>gemstones.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's time for the finale. These are my<n>feelings...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The fireworks grow in intensity,<n>spelling out large letters in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "!UOY KNAHT"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Something the matter? ...Wait, no! The<n>letters are backwards!
choice_data_list: Uh... is it supposed to say, "Thank you?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that message, I think I<n>know why Pearl held this festival<n>tonight. Still...
choice_data_list: Did I do anything worth thanking me for?
Did I do anything worth thanking me for?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, yes you have. You just<n>haven't realized it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I make mistakes like this every now<n>and then, don't I? But every time...<n>you take it in stride.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It was the same when you helped me<n>with the bento shop. I was only<n>thinking of letting more people<n>experience those amazing bentos.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So when you prepared a food truck<n>and helped the owner get his<n>confidence back, I was surprised.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...I always run out alone. Even so,<n>someone always makes sure to have<n>my back. You're that someone,<n>Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Today's festival is my way of<n>showing my appreciation for you.<n>...Even if I messed up at the end.
choice_data_list: I still got your message, loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to hear it, but I really wanted<n>tonight to be perfect. Haha, I'll have<n>to prepare better next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pearl seems to be a bit remorseful<n>about her tendency to rush into<n>things. But honestly... she has no<n>need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I want Pearl to reach the top of the<n>racing world on her own terms—filled<n>with passion, true to her beliefs. And<n>to that end...
choice_data_list:
I want you to stay true to yourself and keep on
charging ahead.

I want you to stay true to yourself and keep on
charging ahead.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I can't win when it comes to<n>you!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Bravo! "Charge ahead," you say?!<n>I've never heard of a more<n>magnificent plan!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Your wish is my command! Let us<n>charge forward into the future!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We will run in every race across the<n>globe... Conquering the racing world<n>isn't just a dream!
choice_data_list: You want to conquer the whole world?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, isn't that what you wanted from<n>me? If I play my cards right, I can<n>even surpass the world itself!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: For example, I could race on the<n>moon against space Umamusume!<n>Haha, the possibilities are limitless!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I have an infinite amount of<n>possibilities at my fingertips—and it's<n>because I know you'll be right beside<n>me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't that right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, dependable words.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The two of us will keep on charging<n>ahead. We'll shine brighter than the<n>world, or anyone else...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No one knows what lies in our future,<n>but what I do know is that whatever<n>may come... I'll be standing right by<n>her side.
